moves.name: Short rollout

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan rolling the ab wheel out a few inches

cues: Kneel with the wheel under your shoulders.
Roll out a few inches, then come back.

moves.name: Halfway rollout

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan halfway through an ab wheel rollout

cues: Same locked arms, same flat back.
Pull back with your abs, not your arms.

moves.name: Full rollout

image.label: real
image.alt: Dan at full extension on the ab wheel

cues: Get your nose as close to the ground as you can.
Don't let your lower back sag.
Come all the way back, slow.
